seen.brief.md: The brief sets a 7.0 bar and lists critical defects for a crayon box and a picture book for children of about 5 years.
seen.look-reference-nan-and-pip.png: The approved style reference shows a soft, round, bright 3D chibi girl and a small chibi dog.
seen.sprout-pat-render.png: Pat, a chibi boy about 0.858 m tall with a green T-shirt and brown shorts, shows the target child size.
seen.storytime-crayon-box.png: Four views of a blue open box with five separate jumbo crayons in red, yellow, green, orange, and purple standing in a row.
seen.storytime-picture-book.png: Four views of an open flat picture book with a red cover, a spine gutter, a yellow oval on the left page, and a blue animal-like shape on the right page.

issues: The crayon tips are smooth domes, not a sharp crayon point; the items still read as crayons.
storytime-crayon-box.notes: A child of about 5 names this item as a box of crayons. Five crayons stand separate in a row, and each reads as a crayon with a colored body and a lighter tip. The box size reads right against the Pat reference for a classroom of this age. No text, no logo, no face, no specks. No part floats or is buried. The crayons and the box are large enough to survive the line art.

issues: The yellow oval on the left page is ambiguous; a child may not name it as a sun, ball, or egg.
The blue shape on the right page reads as a four-legged animal, but it is not fully clear at a small size.
storytime-picture-book.fix: Give the yellow oval a clearer identity, such as a sun with short rays, or replace it with a ball.
storytime-picture-book.notes: A child of about 5 names this item as an open picture book. The red cover, the cream pages, and the rounded gutter read as a hardcover book. The open size fits a lap or a low table. No text, no letter, no logo, no face, no specks. No part floats or is buried. The page pictures are large flat color shapes, so they survive the line art. The item passes, but the pictures are only barely nameable.
